summary: Backend-only testing of AgriScan completed. 17/17 pytest tests passed covering auth (login/logout/me/protected endpoints), CRUD for workers/parcels/products, harvests payment calculation (kilos*price_per_kg + units*price_per_unit), price overrides, list filters (date/worker/parcel/product), daily summary totals and by_worker aggregation, Excel export (headers + xlsx validity), dashboard stats + weekly breakdown, and photo upload via object storage proxy.

minor.issue: Requires auth (CurrentUser dep). If access_token already expired, user cannot cleanly logout to clear refresh cookie. Consider making logout tolerate missing/expired access token.
Returns 200 {ok:true} even if the ID doesn't exist (no 404). Not strictly a bug but less precise.
ObjectId(wid) can raise bson.errors.InvalidId → 500 instead of 400/404 if client sends malformed id.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider FastAPI lifespan context manager.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers reject credentials with wildcard. FRONTEND_URL is appended, so cookies work, but '*' should be removed for production.

action_items: Optional: make /api/auth/logout tolerate missing/expired token so cookies always clear.
Optional: wrap ObjectId(...) conversions in try/except → 400 'ID inválido' instead of 500.
Optional: migrate from @app.on_event to lifespan handler (FastAPI deprecation).
critical_code_review_comments: Payment calc correctly uses product snapshot or overrides; rounded to 2 decimals.
httpOnly cookies set with SameSite=none & Secure as required for cross-site frontend.
doc_out() properly removes MongoDB _id and exposes id.
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if changed - correct.
JWT secret read via get_jwt_secret() -> os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] (will raise if missing - fail-fast ok).
No input sanitization on filter query strings - fine as they're used in Mongo equality.
Harvest update/delete lack ownership/role check; any authenticated user can modify any harvest. Depending on product requirements this may be acceptable (admin app) but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed workers/parcels/products/harvests on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend not tested (per request). Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (17 tests). Admin login + httpOnly cookie flow works. Upload endpoint also works end-to-end against the object storage proxy. All CRUDs, payment calculation, filters, daily aggregation, and Excel export validated.
